SELECT 'closure' k, CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR) a, closure_type b, CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) d FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes_sales', d.fiscal_year, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes_ret', d.fiscal_year, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.sales_line_id) AS VARCHAR)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores_count', CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT store_id) AS VARCHAR), CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), '', '' FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS ns
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2
),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) AS cs
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) sid, m.ns, c.cs, ROUND(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.cs,0),2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year AND c.store_id=m.store_id
WHERE ABS(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.cs,0))>0.5 OR m.ns IS NULL OR c.cs IS NULL
ORDER BY 1,2

WITH x AS (
 SELECT r.store_id, st.store_name, st.open_date, st.close_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END) ty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END) ly,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN d.fiscal_week END) wk_ty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN d.fiscal_week END) wk_ly,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN d.calendar_date END) days_ty,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN d.calendar_date END) days_ly
 FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
 JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id=r.store_id AND st.is_current
 WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)
SELECT *, ROUND(100.0*(ty/ly-1),1) g FROM x ORDER BY g

SELECT r.store_id, d.fiscal_week, SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.net_sales END) ty, SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.net_sales END) ly,
 SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' THEN r.receipts END) rc_ty, SUM(CASE WHEN d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' THEN r.receipts END) rc_ly
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id IN (127,109,105,138,115)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.store_key NOT IN (SELECT store_key FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) orphan_store,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg_lines,
 SUM(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos_qty
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date
                FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) sw
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
